definitionZh: 要为元素添加动画效果，请将其包装在 ` ` 中并设置 `name` 属性。在添加“play”属性之前，动画不会开始。有关所有动画选项的列表，请参阅[属性表](#attributes-and-properties)。
sourceDefinition: To animate an element, wrap it in ` ` and set the `name` attribute. The animation will not start until you add the `play` attribute. Refer to the [properties table](#attributes-and-properties) for a list of all animation options.
